jobDescription.websiteDescription: Technology is integral to virtually everything the D. E. Shaw group does, which is why we seek exceptional software developers with a range of quantitative and programming abilities. Members of our technical staff collaborate on challenging problems that directly impact the firm’s continued success, utilizing their excellent analytical, mathematical, and software design skills as well as some of the most advanced computing resources in the world. Software developers have the opportunity to be part of a collegial, collaborative, and engaging working environment.
jobDescription.responsibilities: Specific responsibilities may include formulating statistical models for our computerized trading strategies, developing distributed systems to analyze and react to incoming data in real time, and creating tools for advanced mathematical modeling.
jobDescription.responsibilitiesHtml: Specific responsibilities may include formulating statistical models for our computerized trading strategies, developing distributed systems to analyze and react to incoming data in real time, and creating tools for advanced mathematical modeling.
peopleWeAreLookingFor: Successful developers have traditionally been the top students in their programs and have extensive software development experience.
We welcome outstanding candidates at all experience levels.

The expected annual base salary for this position is $275,000. Our compensation and benefits package includes substantial variable compensation in the form of a year-end bonus, guaranteed in the first year of hire, a sign-on bonus, a relocation bonus, and benefits including medical and prescription drug coverage, 401(k) contribution matching, wellness reimbursement, family building benefits, and a charitable gift match program.

jobDescription.websiteDescription: Are you looking for new challenges and collaborative problem-solving opportunities at the firm, but finding that the perfect role for you might not be currently available? If you’d like the group to consider your candidacy without specifying a role, we invite you to submit a general, exploratory application here.

The D. E. Shaw group seeks talented individuals with unique perspectives to join the firm as proprietary trading interns. Trader interns sit at the core of the firm’s discretionary investment strategies and take on complex challenges to deepen their understanding of financial markets, investment processes, and trade construction. They gain exposure to the firm’s portfolio management strategies, process-oriented investment philosophy, and risk management in a collaborative and engaging work environment. This is a ten-week program that will take place in New York and is expected to run from June to August 2027.
jobDescription.responsibilitiesHtml:
• Gain exposure to general trading activities, participate in monitoring markets and positions, and analyze market events.
  • Employ a number of technological platforms to analyze market data and make qualitative decisions based on your analyses.
peopleWeAreLookingFor: Candidates who approach problem solving with curiosity, think creatively, and can generate interesting and orthogonal insights (e.g., through involvement in coding or trading competitions, hackathons, investment clubs, or STEM research experience).
Individuals with an aptitude for deep analysis who can recognize connections across a wide range of sources and synthesize information into clear and persuasive messages.
Applicants should be able to support arguments with data and quantitative analysis.
We welcome applicants from any field of study; no previous finance experience is necessary. Students in this program are usually approaching their final year of full-time study.

The position offers a monthly base salary of $25,000, overtime pay, a sign-on bonus of $10,000, travel coverage to and from the internship, and choice of furnished summer housing or a $10,000 housing allowance. It also includes a $3,300 stipend for self-study materials and a $4,000 stipend for personal technology equipment. If you have any questions about the compensation, please ask one of our recruiters.
